_why: Visiting family, written ahead of time so the wall can draw them in when the calendar says they are here. The real one is db/guests.json (gitignored — names and ages are household data); this synthetic copy is never loaded as a fallback, because an example cousin in a real picture would be a stranger. `names` are the words a calendar title uses for that person, matched as whole words in any event in the run's window ("Sam & Alex in town"); a group's names bring every member. Names are only ever used to MATCH — the picture gets the description, never the name. Heights are optional and only reach the prompt as comparisons with the children ("comes up to his chest").

guests.hair: short grey hair and a beard
